title: The Year Privacy Died and VR Was Born
narrative: Snowden reveals the NSA is watching everyone. Bitcoin hits $1,000 then Mt. Gox collapses. The Oculus Rift kickstarts VR. Vine creates the short-form video format. The PS4 and Xbox One launch. Black Lives Matter begins. Google Glass makes everyone uncomfortable.
